title: vitis labrusca f. ficifolia
intro: Vitis labrusca f. ficifolia, commonly known as the grapevine, is a variant of the Vitis labrusca species. It is a type of grapevine known for its unique characteristics and health benefits. The health benefits of Vitis labrusca f. ficifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support antioxidant defenses. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
